title_zh: 维修师傅上门修洗衣机
title_en: Technology and Engineering (12/20): The Repairman Makes a House Call
note_en: 师傅 (shīfu) is the respectful way to address or refer to a skilled tradesperson, such as a repairman, driver or cook, and it goes after the surname like a title: 王师傅 "Master Wang." English has no real equivalent ("the repair guy" sounds casual), so think of it as something like "Mr." reserved for people who work with their hands. Don't confuse it with the homophone 师父, a master who teaches an apprentice or a disciple.
